verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform that handles customer and transaction data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers only payment, transfer, SDK and API features and says nothing about AI training opt-outs or data-use policies, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
